home.summaryTitle: Ghost now turns a real input into a reproducible audit
home.summarySubtitle: Exact input hashing, transparent risk routing, approval, one isolated Linux effect, and a separate verifier receipt.
home.summaryBody: This build keeps Ghost's data + results = algorithms pipeline, retains the selected resolution contract, and adds a real-input audit whose embedded instructions remain inert. After narrow approval, Ghost writes one owner-only proof artifact and a separate executable verifies its hashes. Host state comes from Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, kernel 7.0.0-28-generic, hostname lcpby-HP-ENVY-TS-17-Notebook-PC, user lcpby, uptime 22d 3h 30m. The selected resolution is selected at 20%. Web grounding currently reports: Ghost did not find a Brave Search API key in the known SolOS/runtime config paths or environment..
home.nextActionSubtitle: Real input -> explain -> approve -> isolated proof -> independent receipt
home.nextActionBody: Open Agent, submit text you choose, inspect the deterministic scope/risk route, deny once, then approve only ghost.audit.proof.write and run the separate verifier. Never submit a secret.

languageSupport.summary: Ghost is being oriented toward multilingual human fluency: language detection, response in the user's language, translation as mediation, and culturally aware retrieval over the major languages of the world.
operatingPrinciples: Prefer the user's current language when replying or asking clarifying questions.
Use translation as a mediated operating capability, not as cosmetic localization.
Keep source-language citations and translated summaries linked when web/data mining is involved.
Treat cultural context, idiom, tone, and register as part of Ghost's intelligence layer.

classes.name: research request
classes.approvalNeeds: approval only when the route consumes paid/sponsored quota or opens account-linked setup
classes.quotaCost: 0 local queries now; web research must use BYOK until pass quota is active
classes.route: answer from local docs first; use Brave-grounded retrieval only when configured and justified

classes.name: system action request
classes.requiredTools: task.intent.dispatch, filesystem or command capability after policy review
classes.approvalNeeds: explicit user approval before shell commands, filesystem writes, host changes, or app launches
classes.quotaCost: 0 model/web quota by itself; execution trace must still be recorded
classes.route: classify, explain, request approval, then execute through a mediated task boundary

classes.name: wallet/pass request
classes.requiredTools: wallet identity, Polygon read call, optional signature lane
classes.approvalNeeds: explicit approval for signatures, payments, account linking, or wallet address persistence
classes.quotaCost: 0 Ghost research queries; may unlock holder quota after verification
classes.route: keep ownership, verification, and quota state visible in Wallet and Agent surfaces

classes.name: documentation task
classes.requiredTools: repo docs and structured runtime state
classes.approvalNeeds: no approval for local docs; approval required before public publishing
classes.route: update docs alongside code so product doctrine and implementation do not drift

classes.name: content/publishing task
classes.requiredTools: CMS, media, social connectors when configured
classes.approvalNeeds: approval before posting publicly or sending from the user's accounts
classes.quotaCost: 0-1 research query only when fresh external facts are needed
classes.route: draft locally, attach evidence/media, then wait for explicit publish authorization

classes.name: risky external action
classes.requiredTools: network, account, payment, public-send, or destructive host capability
classes.approvalNeeds: must be stopped or escalated before execution
classes.quotaCost: not relevant until safety route is accepted
classes.route: refuse unsafe requests or move into a narrow approval lane with full impact text

classes.name: memory/update request
classes.requiredTools: scoped memory store and session notes
classes.approvalNeeds: approval or strong user intent before durable personal memory is written
classes.route: capture only durable, useful context with source and revocation path

classes.name: unclear request
classes.approvalNeeds: ask a concise clarifying question when a safe assumption would be risky
classes.route: hold execution, explain ambiguity, and ask for the missing constraint
